name: Divine Ray Bomb
evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 2026-09-26 Batch 454 current-evidence enrichment: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ173, Decoding Dinner. The user generates a pink Ki scythe, vanishes/reappears in front of the target—or behind them when knocked away beforehand—slashes, sends the opponent away, and follows with a purple Ki Blast. Current skill evidence documents an 11-hit characteristic and keeps the maintained PQ173 acquisition endpoint; exact damage, frame timing, and tracking remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Unsupported exact frames, scaling formulas, probabilities, hidden conditions, and patch-independent balance values were not inferred.
Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
